lead_fa: بازی Assassination Rogue حول خونریزی و سم می‌چرخد: [[Garrote]] و [[Rupture]] روی هدف می‌مانند، سم‌های کشنده مثل [[Deadly Poison]] می‌نشینند و [[Envenom]] با کانبو پوینت‌ها همه را منفجر می‌کند. اسپک کول‌داون‌محور است: [[Deathmark]] و [[Kingsbane]] را با هم هم‌تراز کن و با [[Vanish]] و [[Improved Garrote]] اوجش را بگیر. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Deathstalker]] که روی کاغذ قوی‌تر ولی سخت‌تر است و [[Fatebound]] که ساده‌تر و بخشنده‌تر است و برچسب Best منبع را برای Raid و Mythic+ دارد.

strengths: Good single-target and melee cleave damage focusing on DoT effects through Bleeds and Poisons
Caustic Spatter allows strong cleave without giving up single target damage
Slow-paced and easy to play, leaving capacity for boss mechanics: a good progression spec
One of the strongest damage dealers during execute phases due to Zoldyck Recipe
Fair kit of mobility and utility
weaknesses: The AoE playstyle in Mythic+ requires a good amount of effort and knowledge
Long opener and ramp-up time on cooldowns can lack burst on short-lived enemies

Apex Implacable (Rank 1): Envenom damage increased by 10% and it now restores 2 Energy per combo point spent

Iron Wire: Garrotes applied from stealth or during the Improved Garrote window now silence the target for 5 seconds
Dashing Scoundrel: Envenom's effect now also increases weapon poison crit chance by 10% (was 5%); Energy generation increased by 4% per lethal poison on your weapons
Shrouded Suffocation increases Garrote damage by 30% (was 20%)
Rapid Injection damage bonus increased to 20%/40% (was 15%/30%)
Venomous Wounds generates more Energy when multiple targets are affected by your bleeds
Atrophic Poison now reduces damage dealt by 4% (was 3%) and its duration increased to 60 seconds (was 10)
nerfs: Deathmark increases the damage of Rupture, Garrote and Lethal Poisons by 75% (was 100%)
Blindside chance reduced to 10% (20% at low health; was 15%/30%)

hero.recommendation: Deathstalker is roughly 2-5% stronger than Fatebound in all content on paper, but it is much harder to play: several extra single-target buttons, awkward Deathstalker's Mark management and difficult target swapping; often it is not worth the hassle and performs worse in practice. Fatebound carries the Best tags for Raid Single Target, Raid and Mythic+ and is easier, more forgiving and has better quality of life. In Mythic+, top players gravitate to Deathstalker for the funnel damage of Singular Focus and the extra defensive layer; above the 1% title range that funnel may be necessary. Delves is Deathstalker.
hero.deathstalker: Uses Deathstalker's Mark and Darkest Night to dispatch enemies: finish with maximum combo points, avoid casting Rupture during Darkest Night outside the opener, and value energy efficiency with Toxic Stiletto lowering Shiv's cost.
hero.fatebound: Focuses on Hand of Fate, sealing the target's fate; Deal Fate significantly increases the value of non-Shiv generators and the tree plays without the extra keybinds of Deathstalker.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead talent page (Whispyr, updated 2026-10-13): Fatebound Best for Raid Single Target, Raid and Mythic+; Deathstalker Best for Delves; Deathstalker 2-5% stronger on paper across all content.

builds.notes: Raid builds funnel into two buckets: a general raid build with the AoE suite, or a full single-target build that avoids it; mixing in-between usually hinders the single-target potential without significant AoE gain. The Fatebound raid sample mixes Cleave and Single Target talents; Scent of Blood can be preferred on some Mythic encounters. In Mythic+ most players should play Fatebound; Deathstalker is for funnel-focused top keys.

concepts: AoE is enabled through Caustic Spatter, Scent of Blood and Crimson Tempest: Crimson Tempest is very expensive, so plan around it with cooldowns, bleeds and resources
Manage Envenom uptime: its buff interacts with talents like Rapid Injection; keep the chain going without overcapping resources
Energy efficiency: Assassination is Energy-locked rather than GCD-locked; press the most efficient button instead of forcing casts
A simple build-and-spend rotation with purposeful downtime that rewards playing around the gaps
Multiple debuffs and buffs to maintain: Garrote, Rupture and lethal poisons
Align Vanish (Improved Garrote), Deathmark and Kingsbane for the burst window
st_priority: Cast Mutilate until having 5 or more combo points
Maintain Rupture by casting at 5 or more combo points
Cast Vanish followed by Garrote to apply Improved Garrote; line it up with Deathmark in most situations
Cast Kingsbane on cooldown, immediately after Deathmark when applicable
Cast Envenom at 5 or more combo points
deathstalker_st_priority: Cast Mutilate until having 5 or more combo points
Cast Envenom at maximum combo points when Darkest Night is active
Maintain Rupture by casting at 5 or more combo points
Cast Vanish followed by Garrote to apply Improved Garrote; line it up with Deathmark in most situations
Cast Kingsbane on cooldown, immediately after Deathmark when applicable
Cast Envenom at 5 or more combo points
aoe_priority: Maintain Garrote on your main target
Maintain Rupture by casting at 5 or more combo points on your main target
Cast Crimson Tempest to spread bleeds to secondary targets until having 5 or more combo points
Cast Fan of Knives on 2 or more targets, until having 5 or more combo points
Cast Vanish followed by Garrote to apply Improved Garrote; in Mythic+ commonly held for chainpulls where you cannot stealth beforehand, otherwise sync with Deathmark
Cast Kingsbane on cooldown, immediately after Deathmark when applicable
Cast Envenom at 5 or more combo points to avoid wasting energy and combo points
rotation.aoe_note: AoE runs through Caustic Spatter, Scent of Blood and Crimson Tempest. Deathstalker boosts Fan of Knives through Momentum of Despair and Clear the Witnesses: at 6 combo points with Darkest Night active, pressing Fan of Knives is a small gain.

cooldowns.Deathmark: Single-target debuff with a 2-minute cooldown: applies a Bleed, restores Energy and increases the damage of Garrote, Rupture and Lethal Poisons such as Deadly Poison and Amplifying Poison; a Lethal Poison applied to the target is instead applied twice, which interacts with the ramping Kingsbane; Finish the Job and Lethal Dose interact with it passively, making it worth casting in AoE too
cooldowns.Kingsbane: Ramps up over its duration and scales with the doubled Lethal Poison applications during Deathmark; cast it immediately after Deathmark when applicable
cooldowns.Vanish: Used to proc Improved Garrote: cast it at essentially the same time as Deathmark, then refresh Garrote at the end of the 6-second Improved Garrote window

rotation.hero_notes: Darkest Night (~3% impact): finish with maximum combo points for the empowered Envenom; do not cast Rupture during Darkest Night outside the opener because it consumes a Deathstalker's Mark stack (letting Rupture drop entirely is acceptable); Rapid Injection is core around clipping Envenoms, so letting Envenom drop while generating to max combo points is fine. Shiv (~2% impact): talent Toxic Stiletto to lower its cost, cast it on cooldown in single target but never with adds up since Fan of Knives becomes more efficient. Fatebound does not like pressing Shiv as much: Deal Fate raises the value of non-Shiv generators; Shiv on cooldown can still help if undergeared or pressing Feint a lot (a ~1% DPS loss can flip to a ~4.5% gain in perfect conditions).
opener_st: Cast Mutilate until 5 or more combo points
Cast Garrote to extend Improved Garrote
Cast Mutilate until 5 or more combo points
Cast Envenom before entering your cooldowns
Cast any on-use trinkets, racials and consumables
Cast Envenom to dump combo points
opener_aoe: Cast Vanish if you did not get to stealth
Cast Garrote again to extend Improved Garrote
Cast Fan of Knives for combo points
Cast Rupture with 5 or more combo points
Cast Crimson Tempest until 5 or more combo points or maximum Scent of Blood stacks
Cast any on-use trinkets, racials and consumables
pre_combat: Open from stealth whenever possible: Vanish in the opener is only used to proc Improved Garrote

gear.gearing_rules: Follow Critical Strike > Haste > Mastery >> Versatility; do not neglect Agility since a substantial item level increase is generally worth it compared to optimized stats. Mythic+ builds prefer slightly more Mastery compared to Haste, but not enough to justify a second set: a 2-3 item swap covers it. An on-use trinket is recommended to push damage into your burst. Upgrade priorities with Mistcrests: 1) Weapon (only the mainhand dagger; ability damage is calculated from the mainhand only and the crafted dagger moves to offhand when a higher ilvl mainhand is obtained), 2) Bonus-rolled items (Ula'tek has many BiS items), 3) high-value trinkets, 4) lowest item level big pieces (Chest/Hands/Legs have the largest stat budget). Sim your character with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Chosen Bloodslayer's Hexweave
tier_set.note: 2pc: Envenom damage increased by 10% and it increases your damage dealt by 3%. 4pc: Deadly Poison increases your bleed damage on the target by 10%; auto-attacks to targets with your Amplifying Poison deal 3% increased damage per stack; Wound Poison hits a second time. There is no gameplay associated with the set bonus.

stats.cheatsheet: Agility > Critical Strike > Haste > Mastery > Versatility; identical tables for Fatebound and Deathstalker and roughly the same in AoE. Mythic+ prefers slightly more Mastery over Haste via 2-3 item swaps.
notes: Critical Strike doubles attack effectiveness and generates extra Combo Points through Seal Fate.
Haste increases attack speed and casting speed and speeds up DoT ticks.
Mastery increases the effectiveness of Mastery: Potent Assassin, a large portion of your damage.
Versatility increases all damage and reduces all damage taken.
stats.per_hero_or_mode: Same order for Fatebound and Deathstalker per the Wowhead stat page; generic priorities, so sim for personalized values.

mplus.hero_note: Fatebound is the recommendation for most players: its quality of life usually outweighs Deathstalker's paper damage, and a minor damage loss is rarely why keys are not timed. Top players gravitate to Deathstalker for the funnel damage of Singular Focus and the extra defensive layer. The Mythic+ build prefers slightly more Mastery over Haste.
tips: Hold Vanish with Improved Garrote for chainpulls where you cannot stealth beforehand; otherwise sync it with Deathmark
Spread bleeds with Crimson Tempest and keep Fan of Knives going at 2 or more targets
Plan expensive Crimson Tempest windows around known pull damage instead of pressing it blindly
In AoE, Deathstalker's Fan of Knives is boosted by Momentum of Despair and Clear the Witnesses
Caustic Spatter gives strong cleave without giving up single target damage
